LOVING THE APP. I’ve been listening to Hal Elrond’s podcast since the beginning of my spiritual journey in December of 2021. He has expanded my knowledge and broadened my perspective by sharing all of his wisdom from his own experiences and tests of what truly helps someone become their best self. I’ve known for a while that all the components of the SAVERS are necessary to maintain and improve one’s well-being but I hadn’t read TMM and I didn’t have the app until a week ago. Mind you, in 2021 I was relying on Hal’s podcast to expand my knowledge which was more helpful than I could even express, I was working out, journaling, visualizing, meditating, reading, and reciting affirmations daily, just not all in the morning. I had this beautiful routine because my college lifestyle gave me easy access and time to make space for all these things. I moved home in August of 2022 and it got a lot harder to keep up with the lifestyle. It’s been about five months since I’ve felt like my best self, my true self. 
After, downloading the app I was so excited to wake up and finally feel like my level 10 self again. But I didn’t. I didn’t wake up on day one, day two, or day three (that’s today). Although, there was a notification from the app saying something along the lines of you can do your SAVERS at any time. It was a lightbulb moment for me. I was resisting doing TMM because of my previous expectations of how I was doing each activity when I was in college. I think I was overwhelmed by the idea of doing all six even though I know Hal reminds us we can start with one (but I like to do everything and forget that I am not as motivated as I may think😅). Since I missed this morning’s miracle morning, I decided to go for a walk and mark it on the TMM app. And it felt good. So I decided to sit down after the walk and do a five minute guided meditation (with intention!) and I felt so relaxed and blissful. THIS is the feeling I’ve been missing. My inactivity and lack of access to that college campus and routine I made as a college student was holding me back from being my best self. I don’t have to let these limitations hold me back. My journey this time does not and will not look the same as before, and that’s okay. 
Hal’s app lays out everything perfectly for you so that you don’t have to feel overwhelmed, you’re reminded that you don’t have to do this alone, and you don’t have to do it all today. 
I can’t express how grateful I am not only for this app, but for Hal who has been so transparent every step of the way and is constantly helping others to elevate their consciousness and become their best selves. I can’t wait to see what’s waiting for me in my new journey!

No flexibility or options. Condescending tone.. While I really like the miracle morning routine, this app is a frustrating waste of money. Find a friend for accountability. This app is not your friend. If you miss tracking one day you have two options - start completely over (with an atta-boy for your honesty as the belief is that you didn’t do it) or accepting an admonishment to never miss it again. If you do not complete ALL 6 of the ‘savers’ everyday, there is no partial credit. 
Not practical, and unless you are perfect, this app is not encouraging at all. Frankly, I hate this app.

Contact support. Each morning I log my savers however when I return the next morning I’m greeted with a message that I missed a day - gives me 2 options 1) I missed the day ( which I didn’t ) 2) I forgot to log (which I didn’t) - kind of discouraging bc I got this app to keep my progress. Additionally when I tried to click contact support it takes me to the main App not to support . It Basically just opens the app . I’m hoping these bugs are fixed bc I’m very much enjoying the process of miracle morning but the app itself could use bug fixes .

Definitely needs some tweaks. I’m a huge fan of Hal, and having been doing the Miracle Morning for a couple of years, but this app is lacking in user friendliness. I’m actually not a huge fan of the videos either.

I’ve been a night owl my whole life. It would cause me to oversleep in the mornings and be running late all day.
